title: Lineament
summary: LIN'EAMENT, noun [Latin lineamentum.] Feature; form; make; the outline or exterior of a body or figure, particularly of the face. Man he seems in all his lineaments. - The lineaments of the body. - Li

inlines.v: LIN'EAMENT, noun [Latin lineamentum.] Feature; form; make; the outline or exterior of a body or figure, particularly of the face. Man he seems in all his lineaments. - The lineaments of the body. - Lineaments of a character.
